0.risk: Allows any principal to perform specified S3 actions on the entire bucket and its objects, which can lead to unauthorized access and data breaches.
0.remediation: Restrict the resources to only the necessary objects or prefixes. Change the resources attribute in the s3HeadObject statement to only include the specific prefix: ["arn:${data.aws_partition.current.partition}:s3:::${var.av_definition_s3_bucket}/${var.av_definition_s3_prefix}"]
